title: Noise-shaped Sampling and Annealing for Scalable On-the-edge Training of Binary and Ternary AI Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22621v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The training loss of binary and ternary neural networks, expanded as a multilinear polynomial over the discrete weights, is structurally equivalent to the energy of a hierarchical high-order Ising model. We exploit this equivalence to apply Ising solvers to discrete-weight network training, while accounting for a fundamental difference in objectives: an Ising solver seeks the ground state of a fixed energy function, whereas training seeks solutions that generalize to unseen data. Our key contribution is $\Sigma\Delta$-Sampler, an optimizer that reconciles these objectives by embedding a stochastic sampling-and-annealing step as a noisy quantizer inside a first-order $\Sigma\Delta$ noise-shaping loop. The loop pushes noise from weight quantization, high-order frustration, and mini-batch sampling out of the low-frequency adaptation band, so that discrete weight updates follow the smooth descent trajectories embedded in the rugged loss land

translated_title: 面向二值与三值AI模型可扩展边缘端训练的噪声整形采样与退火方法
translated_abstract: 二值与三值神经网络的训练损失在离散权重上展开为多线性多项式后，在结构上等价于层级化高阶伊辛模型的能量。我们利用这一等价性将伊辛求解器应用于离散权重网络训练，同时考虑到二者在目标上的根本差异：伊辛求解器寻求固定能量函数的基态，而训练寻求的是能够泛化到未见数据的解。我们的核心贡献是 ΣΔ-Sampler——一种优化器，它通过在一阶 ΣΔ 噪声整形环路内嵌入一个作为有噪量化器的随机采样-退火步骤来调和上述目标。该环路将来自权重量化、高阶阻挫以及小批量采样的噪声推挤出低频适应频带，使得离散权重更新能够跟随隐藏在崎岖损失地形中的平滑下降轨迹……
tldr: 本文提出ΣΔ-Sampler优化器，利用二值/三值网络训练损失与高阶伊辛模型能量的结构等价性，通过一阶ΣΔ噪声整形环路嵌入随机采样-退火步骤，将量化与采样噪声推挤出低频适应频带，从而实现可扩展的边缘端离散权重网络训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ΣΔ-Sampler, an optimizer that exploits the structural equivalence between binary/ternary training losses and hierarchical high-order Ising energies, embedding stochastic sampling-and-annealing within a first-order ΣΔ noise-shaping loop to push quantization and sampling noise out of the low-frequency adaptation band, enabling scalable on-the-edge training of discrete-weight networks.
